notes.title: Update Ver1.10
notes.notes:
Fixed compatibility issue to work with SteamDeck.

The top menu will not be displayed in SteamDeck's BigPicture mode. The in-game language will be determined by the Steam client's language settings (Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese).
